t: Holding Him to a promise He made
a: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْشُدُكَ عَهْدَكَ وَوَعْدَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ شِئْتَ لَمْ تُعْبَدْ
p: Allāhumma anshuduka ʿahdaka wa waʿdak. Allāhumma in shi'ta lam tuʿbad baʿda-l-yawmi abadā.
m: O Allah, I appeal to You by Your covenant and Your promise. O Allah, if You will, You will not be worshipped after today.
